templates.altText: Barber giving a client a precision fade haircut
templates.reviewNote: REVIEWED (WEBGENIE PR #35 correction gate, P1 — see the dedicated contact sheet). Three non-identical candidate photos existed for this template — 'Barber Shop.png' (client in chair, shop shelving visible), 'Barbershop.png' (barber and client mid-conversation, dark ambient background), 'Barbershop Fade.png' (close-up of clippers mid-fade, warm bokeh-lit shop background) — all three are unambiguously barbershop scenes (no other Gallery template competes for any of them), so the ambiguity was strictly which photo, never which industry. 'Barbershop Fade.png' was kept for its clean left-side negative space and warm, on-brand lighting, confirmed superior to the other two on a real rendered desktop screenshot. Its default mobile crop showed only an out-of-focus, unrecognizable bokeh background with no barber/client visible at all — caught via real screenshot, fixed to '65% center' after comparing four variants, now clearly shows the client's face. No signage, text, watermark, or identifiable third-party brand appears in any of the three candidates.
